question: Select the INCORRECT statement from the following about mitosis.

options.text: Each cell called mother cell divides to form two identical daughter cells.
It helps in growth and repair of tissues in organisms.
The daughter cells have half the number of chromosomes as mother cell.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The daughter cells have half the number of chromosomes as mother cell**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mitosis is a type of **cell division** that results in two genetically identical daughter cells from a single parent cell.
 
• The daughter cells produced by mitosis have the **same number of chromosomes** as the parent cell, making them diploid.
 
• This process is essential for the **growth, repair, and maintenance** of tissues in multicellular organisms.
 
• Unlike meiosis, which results in daughter cells with half the number of chromosomes (haploid), mitosis maintains the **chromosome number** of the original cell.
 
• Mitosis consists of several phases: **Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase, and Cytokinesis**, ensuring accurate chromosome segregation and cell division.
 
• The incorrect statement suggests that mitosis results in daughter cells with half the chromosomes, which is characteristic of **meiosis**, not mitosis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Each cell called mother cell divides to form two identical daughter cells**__

 __
 
• This is a correct statement as mitosis results in the formation of **two genetically identical daughter cells** from a single parent cell.
 
• It ensures that the daughter cells maintain the **same genetic makeup** as the parent cell.
 
 
 
• **It helps in growth and repair of tissues in organisms**__
 __
 
• Mitosis plays a crucial role in **growth, development, and repair** of tissues in multicellular organisms.
 
• It is vital for the replacement of damaged or dead cells, ensuring the proper functioning of tissues and organs.
 
 
 
• **Cells divide for growth**__
 
 
• Mitosis is a fundamental process for **cellular growth** and development, allowing organisms to increase in size.
 
• This division ensures that new cells are available for the expansion and maintenance of tissues.
